reigns.note: Lord of Thebe beneath wooded Placus and ruler over the men of Cilicia — father of Andromache whom bronze-harnessed Hector wed; his seat lay in Cilicia, not at Tarsus itself, but he is the only attested Cilician king in the corpus for this coast.

Swift-footed Achilles led a raid on the sacred city of Eetion at Thebe under Placus, laid it waste, and brought Andromache among the spoil; Apollodorus counts Hypoplacian Thebes among the cities he took before Troy.
